single_variable: Use the Monday range midpoint target only on pre-existing far-classified entry closes (at least 1.5 percent past 1.618). Otherwise retain near target. Compare to 100 percent near on the original E20 positions; no early wick exit or score change.
scope: 398 native paired fills through September 2026; no October midpoint archive. Independent event statistics over all periods, and the exact from-2025 funded account on 254 original opportunities with complete saved near and midpoint legs. Six parts, 3x, original fees / slippage, no funding.
control: Paired hold-near alternative on the exact same event. Compare to randomized midpoint assignment within entry year and side at identical selected count. Weekly paired bootstrap. Both cutoff and midpoint pre-existed, their conditional use is exploratory. No threshold scan.
